name: Prismveil Tailored Chromeskin Showcase Suit
description: A Tier 4 club suit designed explicitly to make augmentation the centerpiece of the look — a structured single-button jacket in deep obsidian holographic-trim silk-synthetic, the lapels edged with a hair-thin line of color-shifting iridescent foil that shifts from violet to copper to silver depending on viewing angle and ambient light. The jacket is cut long in the back, short in the front, with both sleeves removed entirely and replaced by open chrome display channels — structured fabric cuffs at the shoulder that frame chrome arms the way a gallery frames sculpture, the metal polished to mirror finish and highlighted by the jacket's color-shift trim reflecting across it. Underneath, a fitted high-neck underlayer in sheer black mesh with bioluminescent thread woven through in geometric patterns that pulse slowly — breath-rate synchronized via BCI — casting faint light upward onto the jaw. Trousers are slim-cut in the same obsidian holographic fabric, with a discreet horn accommodation loop at the waistband for smaller geneware and a structured exterior tail sheath of matching material for those with longer geneware. Shoes are pointed chelsea boots in liquid-chrome finish, mirror-polished.
functionality: BCI-synchronized bioluminescent thread requires active neural port connection to animate — disconnected, it glows at a static dim baseline. Chrome display channels are precision-fitted to standard aug arm shoulder joints but include micro-adjustment tabs for custom chrome widths. Tail sheath has internal reinforcement to hold shape independently. Horn loop is adjustable via concealed internal drawstring.
what_it_says: This is someone who paid to be looked at and knows exactly what they're doing. The chrome isn't hidden or apologized for — it's lit and framed and presented. The BCI-synced breathing pulse in the mesh says their body and their tech are integrated at a level that costs real QUANTA. Tier 4 confidence: not quite Spire untouchable, but absolutely above asking permission.
worn_by: junior corporate executives on personal time
chrome-augmented professionals with aesthetic investment in their modifications
manufacturer: Vanthorpe Atelier — Tier 4 bespoke label, corponation-adjacent but independently operated
story_hooks: The BCI synchronization pulse is being read by a surveillance system in the club — someone is building a biometric profile on every person wearing BCI-linked clothing tonight.
The mirror-polish chrome arms catch a reflection that shouldn't exist — a face in the crowd that security cameras show isn't there.

A Tier 5 power broker sends a drink to the wearer's table with a note: 'I funded the aug. I want to discuss the terms of that investment.' The chrome wasn't bought — it was installed as part of a deal the wearer may not have fully read.

physical_description.visual_profile: A gallery-ready augmentation display suit that treats cybernetic limbs as sculpture. The silhouette is deliberately asymmetrical and architectural — sharp, elongated jacket with dramatic front-to-back length variation, completely sleeveless to expose chrome arms as the focal point. The overall impression is haute couture meets chrome showroom: intentional, costly, and unapologetically augmentation-centric.
physical_description.fit: Precisely tailored through the torso with minimal give; jacket sits structured and composed. Trousers are slim and geometric. The sleeveless design sits flush against shoulders and collarbone, framing chrome limbs like museum lighting frames an artifact. No room for compromise or slouch.
physical_description.primary_material: Obsidian holographic silk-synthetic blend (jacket and trousers); sheer black mesh with bioluminescent threading (underlayer); polished mirror-finish chrome (arm frames and boot finish); color-shifting iridescent foil trim (lapel edges)
physical_description.texture: Jacket fabric has a liquid, light-reactive quality — smooth and reflective with subtle iridescence. Chrome display channels are mirror-polished to reflect-grade finish. Mesh underlayer is delicate and translucent. Holographic trim has an almost liquid shimmer that shifts with viewing angle.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep obsidian black as dominant color, accented by violet-to-copper-to-silver color-shifting iridescent foil along lapels and cuff frames. Bioluminescent geometry in the mesh underlayer pulses in cool whites/blues. Liquid chrome mirror finish on arms and boots. Overall palette reads as dark luxury with chromatic highlights.
physical_description.closures: Single-button closure at chest (likely magnetic or pressure-lock for that tai lored finish). Chelsea boots likely use elastic side panels with friction-fit. Trousers feature a discreet horn accommodation loop at waistband — functional, not decorative.
distinctive_features: Completely sleeveless design with open chrome display channels framing cybernetic arms like gallery sculpture
Hair-thin iridescent foil lapel edging that color-shifts (violet→copper→silver) with light and angle
Bioluminescent geometric thread pattern in mesh underlayer, synchronized to wearer's breath rate via BCI
Asymmetrical jacket cut: dramatically longer in back, cropped in front
Structured fabric cuff frames at shoulders that integrate seamlessly with chrome limb display
Exterior tail sheath accommodation for longer geneware
Liquid-chrome finish chelsea boots with mirror-polish shine
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4 bespoke — high-end working class with corpo adjacent access. Price point reflects skilled artisanal labor, premium synthetics, and integrated BCI tech. Not Tier 1 corpo exclusivity, but independent atelier prestige.
physical_description.cultural_context: Club culture, augmentation pride, corpo-adjacent underground. Wearing this signals: comfort with visible cybernetics, wealth and aesthetic ambition, participation in elite underground fashion, and deliberate rejection of corpo uniformity despite corp-adjacent pricing. The wearer is *showing*, not hiding.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when first worn — this is a statement piece maintained carefully. Over time, the mirror-polish chrome will show micro-scratches and fingerprints; the holographic fabric may develop subtle wear at flex points. The bioluminescent threads stay reliable but may dim slightly with age. Patching or repair would be rare; this suit is decommissioned, not repaired.
